constraints.name: agenda_active_assignment
constraints.definition: CHECK (deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR (status <> ALL (ARRAY['scheduled'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'arrived'::text])) OR doctor_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: agenda_finite_interval
constraints.definition: CHECK (start_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(start_time) AND isfinite(end_time) AND end_time > start_time AND (end_time - start_time) >= '00:05:00'::interval AND (end_time - start_time) <= '08:00:00'::interval)

constraints.name: agenda_no_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (clinic_id WITH =, doctor_id WITH =, tstzrange(start_time, end_time, '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['scheduled'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'arrived'::text])))

constraints.name: appointments_patient_clinic_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (patient_id, clinic_id) REFERENCES patients(id, clinic_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: appointments_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status IS NOT NULL AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['scheduled'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'arrived'::text, 'completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'no_show'::text])))
